business_summary: TCC Concept Limited engages in the real estate business primarily in India. It operates through Rental; Brokerage and other services; Information and Technology segments. The company carries out leasing of equipped premises and equipment; brokerage from real estate and other services; and information technology services. The company was formerly known as Aaswa Trading and Exports Limited and changed its name to TCC Concept Limited in June 2023. TCC Concept Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Pune, India.
